sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Alpha and Beta travelled to Ethiopia with the Professor and Rassimov. [The Golden Asp] He later fought the Huntik team in King Solomon's mines but was forced to reteat when Lok Lambert invoked the Legendary Titan of Spirit, Tao. [To Be Together]

He was later involved in the attack on Dante Vale's house and fought with the Huntik team. [The Secret of Two Generations] When the Huntik team raided the Professor's castle, he invoked his Jokoul and Strix Titans and fought with Zhalia Moon before being rendered unconscious by her Darksleep power. [The Divine Comedy]

When the Huntik team broke into Organization Central, Alpha fought and was defeated by Dante Vale. [Doorway to Huntik]

When Grier led the Huntik team to the Professor's Castle, Hoffman send him and Beta to fight Dante and Grier. After a long battle, he was defeated by Grier. [An Ally from the Organization]

full_text:
Alpha is the codename of an elite Suit working for the Organization. He always works with his partner, Beta, and together they served as the personal bodyguards of the Professor.

== History ==
Alpha and Beta travelled to Ethiopia with the Professor and Rassimov. [The Golden Asp] He later fought the Huntik team in King Solomon's mines but was forced to reteat when Lok Lambert invoked the Legendary Titan of Spirit, Tao. [To Be Together]

He was later involved in the attack on Dante Vale's house and fought with the Huntik team. [The Secret of Two Generations] When the Huntik team raided the Professor's castle, he invoked his Jokoul and Strix Titans and fought with Zhalia Moon before being rendered unconscious by her Darksleep power. [The Divine Comedy]

When the Huntik team broke into Organization Central, Alpha fought and was defeated by Dante Vale. [Doorway to Huntik]

When Grier led the Huntik team to the Professor's Castle, Hoffman send him and Beta to fight Dante and Grier. After a long battle, he was defeated by Grier. [An Ally from the Organization]

== Abilities ==
Along with his partner, Beta, Alpha is one of the most senior and highly-skilled Suits in the Organization, and is highly trained in the martial arts, able to hold his own against Dante Vale. He was armed with a variety Organization spells and Titans.

=== Spells Utilized ===

*Augerfrost
*Boltflare
*Mindsight
*Poisonfang
*Raypulse
*Thundercut
